Put A = 9 into A − 7 = C: C = 2.

Write B = 2 × C (from 2 × C = B), D = C + 2 (from 2 + C = D) and A = C + 1 (from 1 + C = A). Put these into B − D + A + C = 29: 2 × C − (C + 2) + (C + 1) + C = 29. The minus sign applies to the whole bracket. This simplifies to 3C = 30, so C = 10.
Put C = 10 into 2 + C = D: D = 12.
Put C = 10 into 1 + C = A: A = 11.
Put C = 10 into 2 × C = B: B = 20.

Write A = 2 × C (from A ÷ 2 = C), B = 2 × C − 6 (from A − 6 = B, with A = 2 × C) and D = 2 × C + 4 (from 4 + A = D, with A = 2 × C). Put these into B − D + C + A = 5: (2 × C − 6) − (2 × C + 4) + C + 2 × C = 5. The minus sign applies to the whole bracket. This simplifies to 3C = 15, so C = 5.
